'''Jerzy Czerbniak''' (born 29 September 1947) is a Polish [[sprint (running)|sprinter]]. He competed in the [[Athletics at the 1972 Summer Olympics – Men's 4 × 100 metres relay|men's 4 × 100 metres relay]] at the [[1972 Summer Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/cz/jerzy-czerbniak-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418065636/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/cz/jerzy-czerbniak-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=18 April 2020 |title=Jerzy Czerbniak Olympic Results |accessdate=15 August 2017}}</ref>
